com.receptor.downloadmanager.compatibility: Targets 32-bit iOS 4.0–8.x (below 9.0). iOS 7–8 Safari/app-handoff/workspace installation are unvalidated test paths; arm64 Safari is not included. Earlier user reports cover iPad 1 / iOS 5.1.1 and iPad 4 / iOS 6.1.3, including restored native profile installation. IPA launch failures and DEB/device coverage remain incomplete.
